hook: Wombats literally poop cubes. And it's completely intentional.

scenes.line: Most animals' droppings are round or tubular—they roll everywhere, spread disease, mark territory poorly.

scenes.line: Wombats evolved something different: six-sided, perfectly geometric feces that stack like building blocks.
